plain_text:
Jack Webb appears in 333 recordings across 7 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1946 to 1955. The credits here include performer, producer, and narrator.

In this archive, you will hear Jack Webb most often in Dragnet, Pat Novak, for Hire, Jeff Regan, Investigator, Escape, The Whistler, Dr. Kildare, and Mr. Malone.

Characters credited here include Joe Friday, Pat Novak, and Jeff Regan.
